Heart of Ohio Family Health Centers operates six clinical sites across four Central Ohio zip codes, serving more than 21,000 patients through over 100,000 encounters annually. Our patient population carries a disproportionately high social determinants of health burden, including a significant volume of high-risk pregnancies and individuals for whom Heart of Ohio Family Health is the only consistent source of primary care. 

Retail pharmacy operations generated 43% of the organization's gross revenue in FY2025. The 340B program functions as operational infrastructure, not a discrete initiative. 340B savings are absorbed into the daily cost of delivering care across primary care, dental, behavioral health, prenatal and pharmacy services. Without 340B, entire service lines would be financially unviable and thousands of patients would lose access to care. 

The 340B program has reduced our reliance on federal and state grant funding to less than 7% of our total operating budget. This stability translates directly to outcomes: Heart of Ohio Family Health has received multiple HRSA Quality awards as well as national recognition from the American Heart Association for positive clinical outcomes achieved with a patient population facing substancial barriers to care.
